title: 1638 Prairie's gateway now leads to its porch stair on flags
items: The timber house at 1638 Prairie gets a front walk. It comes in through the gateway between the two gate piers, runs north along the back of the fence and turns to the foot of the porch stair.

Through the old photograph's camera, the flags land where the picture shows pale ground: in the gateway and at the bottom of the stair. The rest of the walk is hidden by the hedge, so its line is a reconstruction, noted under the house's liberties.
